name: Critical Reasoning / Assertion & Reason
shortcutSummary: Determine if the Assertion is true/false independently. Then check if the Reason is true/false. Finally, check if the Reason correctly explains the Assertion.
conceptExplanation: Critical Reasoning and Assertion-Reason questions test logical thinking. In Assertion-Reason: you get two statements (Assertion and Reason) and must determine their individual truth and whether the Reason explains the Assertion.

subtopics.name: Critical Reasoning / Assertion & Reason — Core Concepts
subtopics.explanation: Critical Reasoning and Assertion-Reason questions test logical thinking. In Assertion-Reason: you get two statements (Assertion and Reason) and must determine their individual truth and whether the Reason explains the Assertion.
shortcuts: Independent Truth Check: Evaluate A and R separately for truthfulness.
Explanation Test: Even if both A and R are true, R must be the correct explanation of A.
Common Trap: Both statements may be true but completely unrelated — in that case, R is NOT the correct explanation.
